newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cartel office opposes Merck plans to buy KMF.
newsitem.headline: Cartel office opposes Merck plans to buy KMF.

text.p: German cartel authorities are seeking to stop chemical group Merck KGaA from proceeding with plans to take over KMF Laborchemie Handels GmbH, a spokeswoman for the Federal Cartel Office told Reuters.

The takeover would strengthen Merck's already dominant position in the German market for laboratory reagents, the spokeswoman said, confirming industry speculation that Merck had received an official warning against the deal.
The cartel office was so concerned about the deal that it might consider an outright ban on the transaction, she added.

Merck, which has annual sales of around 1.6 billion marks ($957.5 million) in the laboratory segment, announced its intention to buy KMF in October last year. The unit was to be combined with Merck's subsidiary Bender & Hobein.
The deadline for a final decision from the cartel office and a response from Merck has since been extended until April 24.
